constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

doneWhen remains the sealed product success predicate; reviewReady and landReady requirements may gate review or commit but never redefine SOLVED.
Repository-global generated outputs are proven in an isolated HEAD plus exact-candidate snapshot and never accepted from a contaminated dirty worktree.
Verifier verdict files are bounded regular workspace files containing canonical plain JSON data; the immutable review owns fingerprint, scope, and paths.

findings.summary: Store append and replay use live JSON and collection methods, allowing canonical verifier evidence and findings to be rewritten in durable bytes or replay.
Candidate and aggregate verification still use live array, Set, regexp, and string operations, allowing the exact candidate and its rejection to disappear.
Live Array.prototype.push can erase the required aggregate-approval problem consumed by terminal verification and landing audit admission.
ProjectState retains a live findings push, allowing the projected ledger to lose the exact verifier rejection while the durable event remains present.
The hostile-tail guard omits failing JSON, filter, and push attacks and restores part of the hostile runtime before full verification-state replay.
